message:
I remember the last time we had a power outage, my friend Lisa was visiting. As soon as the lights went out, she started rummaging through her bag for her phone charger, convinced we'd be stranded in the dark forever. Meanwhile, I was calmly pulling out my trusty flashlight and a couple of power banks, ready to keep our devices charged and spirits high.

We ended up playing cards by flashlight, laughing at her dramatic flair while keeping cozy with some snacks. It was a gentle reminder that a little preparation can turn a potentially stressful situation into a fun evening. 

What’s your go-to tip for staying comfortable during a blackout? 🕯️
